Book correction: Part (a) asks for the exact height, but the book gives only the decimal 352.6 m (after rounding \sqrt{518625} to 720.2). The exact height is h = \frac{-15 + \sqrt{518625}}{2} = \frac{15(\sqrt{2305} - 1)}{2} \approx 352.58 m. In part (b) the book prints \tan^{-1}\frac{367.6}{120} = 71.93^{\circ}; the value is 71.92^{\circ} (71.921^{\circ}). The final answer \theta_2 \approx 0.72^{\circ} is right: 7
